recovery.reason: Worker candidate generation succeeded. Automated promotion failed only because the GitHub App token could not push commits containing .github/workflows files without workflow-file permission. The candidate was reconstructed on a review branch from the exact worker bundle, then recovery-hardened before the Astra gate.

verification_results.note: Astra Review #2 rejected exact head eed83559 on three remaining adversarial gaps. All three corrections are implemented; exact-head CI must pass before re-review.

review_focus: credential block scalar variants including |2, |2-, |-2, >2, >+2 and comments leave no secret sentinel in results/corrections
explicitly supplied implementation_guidance null/number/object/blank/whitespace fails BLOCKED_INVALID_VERDICT while absence/nonblank string remains valid
persistence gate directly validates against the published REVIEW_CONTRACT schema
valid approval, rejection, retry-limit and blocked outputs pass both schema and runtime semantic validation
malformed findings, correction packages, prohibited properties, invalid types and status payloads fail and cannot reach PERSIST_ONCE
result_digest/idempotency integrity is recomputed before persistence and malformed existing records are rejected
complete immutable snapshot/verdict binding and full-identity idempotency from Review #1 remain intact
self-hosted Windows reviewer disabled by default; zero spend; no live authorization; no local inference; no conversation access; no merge/auto-merge
known_limitations: TASK-0003 does not implement or enable live Sign in with ChatGPT authorization or live reviewer inference. That activation remains a separate post-approval task requiring one-time user interaction.

The current GitHub App used by the autonomous controller cannot push workflow-file changes, so this candidate required trusted recovery promotion through the GitHub connector. This is recorded rather than silently weakening repository permissions.

findings.issue: Evidence and verdict identity were not fully bound.
findings.correction: Compare the complete request to an independently supplied immutable snapshot; bind verdict to candidate SHA and canonical snapshot digest; test every identity field plus missing/extra changed files and CI evidence.

findings.issue: Credential sanitization and authorization metadata separation were incomplete.
findings.correction: Redact complete credential blocks and secret-bearing keys; enforce strict host-local authorization metadata allowlist; adversarially test multiline blocks, token keys, nested refresh tokens, private keys and PAT-like strings.

findings.issue: Malformed finding fields were accepted and BLOCKED runtime output conflicted with the published schema.
findings.correction: Require nonblank strings and criteria before sanitization; publish status-specific schema including blocked reason; verify all emitted result classes against runtime/schema contract.

findings.issue: Idempotency key conflated distinct review identities.
findings.correction: Derive identity from canonical immutable snapshot and result digest; exact repeat is DUPLICATE_NOOP; conflicting result under one identity is explicit CONFLICT_BLOCKED; distinct repository/PR identities do not collide.

findings.issue: Credential block variants with explicit indentation indicators could leak into correction data.
findings.correction: Treat any credential-bearing YAML block scalar beginning with | or > conservatively, independent of chomping/indentation indicator ordering; add end-to-end variant/comment tests.

findings.issue: Explicit null implementation_guidance was treated like an absent field.
findings.correction: Distinguish field absence from supplied values; any supplied guidance must be a nonblank string before sanitization.

findings.issue: Persistence validator did not fully enforce the published JSON Schema.
findings.correction: Validate emitted/persisted results directly against REVIEW_CONTRACT.schema.json plus semantic digest/invariant checks; reject malformed incoming and existing records before persistence.
